sentences.text:
Coram : Manish Pitale And
 Y. G. Khobragade, Jj.
 Date : 04.09.2025

Per Court :
1.

In this petition on 20.08.2025, it was recorded that the learned AGP was to take clear instructions in the matter as regards the status of the proposals for acquisition of the lands of the petitioners.
2. It is not seriously disputed that the possession of the lands of the petitioners was taken as far back as in the year 2008.
The respondent authorities did not initiate any concrete steps for acquisition of their lands and only some exercise of measurement appears to have been carried out in the year 2011.
It is a matter of record that the said land was utilized for construction of percolation tank.

3. It is also a matter of record that much later, i.e., on 22.09.2023, respondent authorities issued notices to the petitioners for joint measurement of the lands and thereafter, no further concrete steps were taken in the matter, due to which the petitioners have been constrained to approach this Court in the present petition.

sentences.text: We find that in such circumstances, the petitioners having been deprived of possession of their lands as far back as in the year 2008, they would not only be entitled to just and fair compensation but also to the relief of rental compensation as per the policy of the respondent - State.

The respondents are, therefore, put to notice that in this petition, that this Court shall take up the issue of entitlement of rental compensation payable to the petitioner in the light of the said aforesaid admitted facts.

Appropriate directions shall also be issued for expediting the steps being taken now under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: We also intend to issue directions under Section 40 of the said Act of 2013.
5. In view of the above, the respondents are directed to take immediate steps for joint measurement as proposed in the light of the notice issued as far as on 22.09.2023.
We expect the aforesaid exercise of joint measurement to be completed within a period of four weeks from today.

We also direct that in terms of Section 40 of the Act of 2013, particularly in terms of sub Section (3) thereof,
the respondents shall take immediate steps for payment of 80% of the compensation for the land of the petitioners of which possession was taken, as may be estimated by the Collector/Sub Divisional Officer.

6. On the next date of hearing, we expect the respondent authorities to place before this Court the amount equivalent to 80% compensation that shall be paid to the petitioners in the facts and circumstances of the present case.
7. List for further consideration on 06.10.2025.

(Y. G. KHOBRAGADE, J.) (MANISH PITALE, J.)
